answer: The network builds a directed trust graph where each agent’s outgoing edge capacity equals the stake it locked on a knoll‑anchored escrow contract. When a new agent joins, its incoming trust must flow through a bridge node that aggregates sparrow‑rated attestations, and a max‑flow algorithm limits any cut‑edge to the total escrow of the source cluster, so a Sybil swarm can draw reward only up to the combined stake it posted.
